# Rosternado — Full Product & Knowledge Documentation

> Complete reference manual for Rosternado (https://rosternado.com), the flight roster sharing app for aviation crew (pilots and cabin crew) and their friends and family.

---

## 1. Product Overview

Rosternado is a mobile application for iOS and Android designed specifically for airline pilots and cabin crew, as well as the family members and friends who follow their flight schedules.

### Philosophy: Built by a Pilot, Free of Clutter
Aviation apps often try to do everything at once — cramming in weather forecasts, METARs, TAFs, NOTAMs, operational documents, and invasive advertisements. Rosternado was created by an active airline pilot who wanted a clean, focused, privacy-respecting tool with one sole mission:
- Give crew an elegant, offline-ready view of their roster.
- Solve the real-world friction of knowing when your crew friends are free in the same city.
- Let family at home know when you are flying, landing, or safely off duty.

### What is Deliberately Missing
- **No weather reports**: Look out the window or use official EFB tools.
- **No METARs or NOTAMs**: Legal flight briefings belong in certified airline channels, not a social roster app.
- **No advertisements**: Clean, focused interface without banners or popups.
- **No analytics or surveillance trackers**: Rosternado does not sell user data or track browsing behavior.
- **No public rosters**: Rosters are completely private and only shared with explicitly accepted friends.
- **No auto-sync with crew portals**: The roster updates only when the user imports it again or edits duties. Rosternado is not an official or primary source for duties; the airline's crew portal remains the source of truth.

---

## 2. Core Features

### One-Tap Roster Import
Crew members don't need to manually retype flights or copy dates across from PDFs:
1. Open the airline's roster portal directly within the in-app secure browser view.
2. Sign in with standard airline credentials.
3. Tap "Save". Rosternado parses all duties and imports them into a clean chronological roster.

### Colour-Coded Duty Timeline
Every type of duty is assigned an intuitive colour so a busy month is readable at a glance:
- **Flight**: Active flight sectors.
- **Standby / Reserve**: Standby duties with start and release times.
- **Training**: Simulator checks, dangerous-goods refresher, CRM courses, recurrent training.
- **Day off**: Scheduled rest days.
- **Leave**: Annual leave and vacation blocks.
- **Office**: Ground duties, meetings, and office assignments.
- **Transfer**: Positioning / deadhead flights and ground transport.

#### Multi-Sector Grouping
Multi-leg flights group automatically under a single card. A three-sector day (e.g., SAW–ADB–AYT–SAW) reads as one unified duty card with expandable sector details, rather than three disconnected items.

### Your Crew on Every Flight
- Open a flight to see who is flying it: flight deck and cabin, as the airline's roster lists them.
- Departure and arrival times are shown in both the airport's local time and Zulu.

### Friend Radar
Friend Radar displays accepted crew friends on an interactive map:
- Friends are pinned at their home base or layover destination.
- When an accepted friend is currently flying an active sector, their flight route, progress, and estimated arrival time are displayed.
- **Important note on privacy and accuracy**: Positions are approximate and refreshed periodically. It is intended as a helpful snapshot for friends and family, not as an air traffic control or surveillance radar.

### Plan a Meetup
Finding overlapping free time between crew members across changing shift patterns, different bases, and differing time zones is tedious to calculate by hand:
- Select one or more crew friends.
- Rosternado compares everyone's rosters and calculates the exact windows where everyone is off at the same time in the same city.
- Shows the start time, end time, and total duration of each free window in local time.
- Share a window as a boarding-pass card (the time, the place, who is coming) straight into a group chat.

### Google Calendar Sync
- Optional, for crew: sync your roster to Google Calendar.
- Rosternado creates a calendar of its own in the user's Google account and writes roster duties into it.
- Uses only the `calendar.app.created` permission, so it cannot read the user's other calendars or events.
- The user chooses which duty types are synced. Crew names in flight events are optional.
- Can be turned off at any time in Settings -> Google Calendar Sync.

### AI Connector (MCP)
- Optional: connect Rosternado to an AI assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT (a remote MCP server, added as a custom connector) and ask about your roster in plain words, e.g. "When did I last fly with Ali?", "Where did I lay over last week?", "How many sectors have I flown this month?", "When can Ali and I meet in Istanbul?", "Which days are Mehmet and I both off?".
- Read-only: it cannot add, edit or delete duties or send friend requests. Times are scheduled roster times, not actual flight times.
- Available to crew with Pro (own roster, flight crews, layovers, stats, plus friends' rosters) and, free, to every non-crew account (friends list, crew friends' rosters, meetup times, shared days off).
- Friends' rosters are visible only from today to the end of next month, and any user can stop friends' assistants reading their roster (Settings -> Privacy -> Friends' AI assistants).
- Server URL: https://gwvmlvahihjzcdjqulws.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
- Tools (9): My roster, My roster stats, My layovers, Where was I, Flights with a crew member, My friends, A friend's roster, Find meetups, Days off together.

#### Before you start: add a password
The Rosternado sign-in page that the assistant opens only accepts an email and password. Users who signed up with Google or Apple add a password once in the app (Google/Apple sign-in keeps working):
1. In the Rosternado app, open the menu -> Profile.
2. Under Connected Accounts, tap Link next to Email & Password.
3. Confirm with Google or Apple (Verify Identity).
4. If the email ends in @privaterelay.appleid.com (Apple's Hide My Email), enter your real address instead and open the confirmation link on the same phone.
5. Enter a password (at least 6 characters) twice and tap Save.

#### Add it to Claude (mobile app, claude.ai or desktop app)
1. Settings -> Connectors.
2. Tap + at the top right -> Add custom connector.
3. Name: Rosternado. URL: the server URL above. Tap Continue.
4. Leave the defaults (Sign in now, Register automatically) and tap Add.
5. On the Rosternado sign-in page, sign in with your app email and password and tap Allow.
6. Rosternado appears in Connectors with its 9 tools. The "This connector isn't verified by Anthropic" notice is shown for every custom connector. The Free plan allows one custom connector.

#### Add it to ChatGPT (browser only)
The connector must be added on chatgpt.com in a web browser (phone or computer); the ChatGPT app cannot add it. Once added, it works in the ChatGPT app too. Custom MCP servers may not be available on every ChatGPT plan.
1. Open chatgpt.com in a browser, sign in, open Settings -> Plugins (under Integrations).
2. Tap Browse directory.
3. Tap + at the top right -> Add custom MCP server.
4. Name: Rosternado. Connection: Server URL, paste the server URL above. Authentication: OAuth.
5. Tick "I understand and want to continue" and tap Create as a plugin.
6. On the Rosternado sign-in page, sign in with your app email and password and tap Allow.

Setup guide with screenshots: https://rosternado.com/ai.html (Claude: https://rosternado.com/ai.html#claude, ChatGPT: https://rosternado.com/ai.html#chatgpt; Turkish: https://rosternado.com/tr/ai.html)

### Friend Alerts
- Opt-in notifications per friend.
- Get notified the moment an accepted friend's new monthly roster drops, making it easy to schedule meetups before schedules fill up.
- Kept off by default so users are never spammed.

### Hangar
- Pick the aircraft that flies over your roster: nine types, from the A320 and 737 to the 777, 747 and A380.
- Swipe through each aircraft's liveries, or leave it on Auto.
- The pick is saved on the device only and flies on every roster the user opens.

### Blocking & Reporting
- Nobody sees a roster without a friend request that one person sent and the other accepted.
- Blocking someone removes the friendship, hides the roster from them at once and stops their friend requests. They are not told.
- Reporting a profile sends it to the developer for review. The reported person is not told.
- Blocks can be undone in Settings -> Privacy -> Blocked Users.

### Offline-First Architecture
- Every roster is locally cached on the device.
- Roster data loads instantly without cell coverage, whether mid-flight at 38,000 feet, in airplane mode, or at overseas layover hotels with patchy Wi-Fi.
- Duties added, edited or deleted offline are sent when the device is back online.
- Roster import, Friend Radar and Google Calendar sync need a connection.

### Friends & Family Companion Mode
- Non-aviation family members and friends can create an account and follow an accepted crew member's schedule for free.
- Family members can check whether a crew member is in the air, landing, or home without having to ask for roster screenshots.

---

## 3. Pricing & Membership Tiers

Rosternado offers clear, transparent pricing with no hidden fees or ad-supported tiers.

| Tier | Price | Features & Inclusions |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Friends & Family** | Free forever | • Follow and view accepted crew friends' rosters.<br>• See flight progress and arrival status.<br>• Unlimited viewing.<br>• *Note: Roster import is not included; this tier is for following, not flying.* |
| **Crew — Free** | Free | • 5 duty operations per month (combined total of adds, edits, and deletes).<br>• Multi-leg flights count as a single operation.<br>• Counter resets on the 1st of each month.<br>• 1 roster import.<br>• Unlimited viewing of crew friends' rosters.<br>• Friend Radar, Plan a Meetup and Google Calendar sync included. |
| **Crew — Pro** | $2 / month<br>*(or $20 / year)* | • Unlimited duty operations (adds, edits, deletes).<br>• Unlimited roster imports for updated schedules.<br>• All features in the Free Crew tier included. |

### Subscription Management
Subscriptions are processed securely via Apple App Store or Google Play Store. Subscriptions are managed and cancelled directly in the user's Apple ID or Google Play account settings. Deleting a Rosternado account does **not** cancel an active subscription.

---

## 4. Airline Support & Integrations

### Verified Airlines (Dedicated Parsers Tested on Real Rosters)
1. **Pegasus Airlines** (`PC`) — Full in-app portal import for Pegasus crew operating out of Sabiha Gökçen (SAW) and other bases.
2. **Turkish Airlines** (`TK`) — In-app crew roster portal import for Turkish Airlines pilots and cabin crew.
3. **AJet** (`VF`) — In-app roster portal parser for AJet crew.
4. **SunExpress** (`XQ`) — Roster import for Antalya (AYT), Izmir (ADB), and other SunExpress bases.

### Beta Airlines (CAE "Crew Access" Tenant Support)
The following 15 airlines use the CAE crew portal infrastructure and can be imported in beta:
- Air India (`AI`)
- Allegiant (`G4`)
- Azul (`AD`)
- Iberojet (`E9`)
- Ethiopian Airlines (`ET`)
- Garuda Indonesia (`GA`)
- Hong Kong Airlines (`HX`)
- Japan Airlines (`JL`)
- Jetstar (`JQ`)
- Jet2 (`LS`)
- Bangkok Airways (`PG`)
- Akasa Air (`QP`)
- SriLankan Airlines (`UL`)
- Wizz Air (`W6`)
- HOP! (`A5`)

*Beta Note: Because individual airline tenant configurations may vary, if an import format encounters an issue, crew can report it via info@rosternado.com and the parser will be updated.*

### Manual Duty Entry
Around 75 additional global airlines are pre-populated in the airline selector for manual duty entry.

### Requesting a New Airline
Crew can request a new airline parser by sending an email to `info@rosternado.com` with:
- Airline Name
- Roster website URL
- Two copies of the roster page and a screenshot of it. On a computer (recommended): Chrome or Edge developer panel → Elements → Copy outerHTML, once in the computer layout and once with the device toolbar's phone view (two .txt files). On an Android phone: `view-source:` + Print → Save as PDF, once in the phone layout and once in desktop view; this can miss rosters that load after the page opens.

Step-by-step guide, including what the saved file contains and how it is handled: https://rosternado.com/add-your-airline.html

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How do I upload my roster?
Tap the Roster Download icon in the top right corner of the mobile app. The in-app web browser opens your airline's crew portal. Log in with your standard airline credentials and tap **Save**. Your duties will be parsed automatically.

### Does Rosternado sync automatically with my airline's crew portal?
No. Your roster only changes when you import it again (Roster Download -> Save) or edit duties yourself; changes made by crewing are not picked up automatically. Rosternado is not an official source and should not be used as your primary reference for duties. Always check your company's crew portal.

### Who can see my roster?
Only friends whom you have explicitly accepted. Your roster is private by default, not indexed by public search engines, and never accessible to unapproved users.

### How do I block or report someone?
Tap the "…" button on their friend request or search result, or swipe a friend's row to the left. Blocking removes them from your friends, hides your roster from them and stops their requests; they are not told. A report goes only to the developer. To undo a block: Settings -> Privacy -> Blocked Users.

### Can I see my roster in Google Calendar?
Yes, if you are crew: Settings -> Google Calendar Sync. Rosternado creates its own calendar in your Google account and writes your duties into it. It cannot read your other calendars or events. You choose which duty types are synced.

### Does it work without a connection?
Yes. Your roster and your friends' rosters are stored on your device. Duties you add, edit or delete offline are sent when you are back online. Roster import, Friend Radar and Google Calendar sync need a connection.

### Which time zone are the times in?
Your choice, in Settings -> Time Display: UTC, the local time of each airport, your base, or your device. Opening a flight always shows both the airport's local time and Zulu.

### How do I change the aircraft at the top of my roster?
Settings -> Hangar. Pick an aircraft and a livery, or leave it on Auto. The choice is saved on your device only.

### What if my airline is not yet supported for automated upload?
You can manually add, edit, and categorize duties using the pre-configured airline database. You can also contact support to request an automated parser for your airline.

### Can I ask Claude or ChatGPT about my roster?
Yes. Add Rosternado as a custom MCP connector (server URL https://gwvmlvahihjzcdjqulws.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp). In Claude: Settings -> Connectors -> Add custom connector. In ChatGPT: add it on chatgpt.com in a browser (Settings -> Plugins -> Browse directory -> + -> Add custom MCP server); the ChatGPT app cannot add it, but it works in the app once added. Guide: https://rosternado.com/ai.html

### Why does the AI connector ask for a password when I signed up with Google or Apple?
The Rosternado sign-in page that Claude or ChatGPT opens only accepts email and password. Add a password once in the app: Profile -> Connected Accounts -> Link next to Email & Password. Google or Apple sign-in keeps working.

### How do I cancel or manage my Pro subscription?
Subscriptions are managed directly by Apple or Google:
- On iOS: Open Settings -> tap your Apple ID -> Subscriptions -> Rosternado.
- On Android: Open Google Play Store -> tap Profile -> Payments & Subscriptions -> Subscriptions -> Rosternado.

### Does deleting my account cancel my subscription?
No. Pro is billed by the App Store or Google Play and belongs to your Apple ID or Google account, so deleting your Rosternado account does not stop billing. Cancel the subscription in your store first (see above).

### How do I permanently delete my account and data?
In the app, navigate to **Profile -> Delete Account** and confirm. This permanently purges your profile, rosters, duties, and friend connections from the server.
